description: This file contains cryptographic comparison functions for big numbers (BIGNUM), including constant-time comparison and utility functions for BN objects.

methods.name: bn_cmp_words_consttime
methods.description: Performs a constant-time comparison of two big number word arrays.

methods.name: BN_cmp
methods.description: Comparison of two BIGNUMs considering sign.

methods.name: bn_less_than_words
methods.description: Checks if one word array is less than another in constant time.

methods.name: BN_abs_is_word
methods.description: Checks if the absolute value of a BIGNUM equals a specific word.

methods.name: BN_cmp_word
methods.description: Compares a BIGNUM with a single word.

methods.name: BN_is_zero
methods.description: Checks if a BIGNUM is zero.

methods.name: BN_is_one
methods.description: Checks if a BIGNUM is one.

methods.name: BN_is_word
methods.description: Checks if a BIGNUM equals a specific word.

methods.name: BN_is_odd
methods.description: Checks if a BIGNUM is odd.

methods.name: BN_is_pow2
methods.description: Checks if a BIGNUM is a power of two.

methods.name: BN_equal_consttime
methods.description: Constant-time comparison of two BIGNUMs for equality.
